evidence.title: Rulebase | AI agent monitoring for customer-facing agents

name: Rulebase
summary: AI agent monitoring for customer-facing agents: reviews every conversation and shows the fix that improves resolution.
description: Rulebase monitors AI and human customer conversations across chat, voice and workflows, detects silent failures, quality gaps and policy breaches, compares failed AI journeys with human resolutions, and points to the prompt, knowledge, tool or workflow change to make. It also publishes an MCP server for helpdesks and contact centres and an open-source library of 149 agent skills for customer operations, QA, compliance and RevOps.
contains: monitors AI and human conversations across chat, voice and workflows
149 open-source agent skills, installed with npx rulebase-skills, vendor-neutral
MCP directory covering Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, Crisp, Aircall, Five9, Genesys Cloud CX, NICE CXone and Avaya
detects silent failures, missed complaints and risky handoffs; scores QA against SOPs
customer case studies: Qonto, Rho, Lesaka; SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, PCI DSS
